Subject: Observability inventory & network circuit audit — post go-live verification

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the successful flip this morning. Quick note to kick off a short verification pass from our side so we can close the go-live checklist:

- Confirm all collector agents are reporting to the private observability cluster (expected host: obs-prod-01.acme.internal).
- Verify that the circuit-level SNMP/flow telemetry we ingested during the cutover is complete (we expect ~3.1M flows for the 06:00–08:00 window).
- Reconcile circuit inventory vs. routing table changes (any missing circuits flagged for follow-up).

I've attached an initial inventory export and the audit template so we can each tick boxes and share results. Marcus / Irene — can you take inventory ownership and run the health checks below? Alex, if you can confirm agent visibility and any local ACLs that might block telemetry, that would be great.

Attachments: [Attachment: onprem-observability-inventory.csv (csv)] [Attachment: circuit-audit-log.txt (text)]

Thanks —
Monica

Thanks Monica — taking point on the inventory reconciliation. Quick plan and what I'll run this morning: 

1) Collector health sweep (script: /ops/bin/collector_sweep.sh) — compare local agent uptime against central ingestion timestamps.
2) Flow consistency check — run flow-compare tool against stored windows (INF-4921). Expect to see flow gap alerts if ACLs dropped packets.
3) Circuit-to-route mapping audit — cross-reference the attached export with the BGP state dump.

I'll attach the runbook update (runbook-v2.md) with the exact commands I ran and a short checklist. If I find any telemetry gaps I'll capture pcap snippets and escalate to EdgeOps for the fabric-level telemetry.

Monica / Marcus —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick heads up: during the 06:45–07:10 window we saw an intermittent telemetry drop on the east fabric (possible ACL misconfiguration on the new edge pair). Our SOC flagged a ~12 minute gap in collector ingestion for obs-prod-01.acme.internal. I pulled the local agent logs — attaching a small excerpt.

What we need from Redwood: can you confirm whether any of the new routing policies you pushed would cause telemetry packets to be dropped or redirected to a quarantine VRF? If so we'll need a config change and a brief fabric maintenance window.

Attached: [Attachment: agent-log-excerpt.txt (text)]

Alex Chen
Lead SRE, Acme Health
alex.chen@acmehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, EdgeOps Solutions <ops@edgeops.io>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability inventory & network circuit audit — post go-live verification

Alex — thanks for the quick catch and log excerpt. Final readout from our verification pass below (short and actionable):

Summary (completed checks):
- Collector health: 98.6% of agents reported within expected window. The 12-minute gap you saw corresponds to a transient policy we pushed to prevent storms during BGP adj-change; policy ID: redwood-push-20270319-bridgeguard.
- Flow ingestion: flow-compare returned 3,089,412 flows (expected ~3.1M). Missing ~10k flows clustered around the 06:45–07:10 window.
- Circuit audit: 2 circuits flagged as mismatched (circuit IDs: ACME-EAST-011, ACME-EAST-012). Root cause: late ACL insertion on edge pair causing SNMP polling to occasionally fail.

Action items and next steps:
1) Marcus will remove the temporary bridgeguard policy for the east pair and re-run the collector sweep (ETA: 30m).
2) EdgeOps (cc'd) to verify fabric ACL insertion sequence and confirm no persistent drops — please reply here with findings.
3) Monica/Irene to reconcile the inventory CSV and push an updated baseline to Acme's Drive folder (link below).
4) We'll schedule a 20-minute maintenance window tonight at 22:00 PT if EdgeOps needs control-plane changes.

Artifacts attached: circuit-audit-log.txt (detailed diffs), runbook-v2.md (commands executed), onprem-observability-inventory.csv (updated baseline).

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcx-observability-acme
Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4921

If there are no objections from EdgeOps, Marcus and I will proceed with the bridgeguard rollback and post-change verification. I'll post a brief ops note in the morning with the final reconciliation.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134
